annual_state.observed_quadrat: at least one RM or ZM row for that permanent quadrat in that year
annual_state.focal_presence_quadrat: at least one ZM row for that permanent quadrat in that year, regardless of whether its Percent Cover is numeric or NA
annual_state.focal_cover_quadrat: mean numeric ZM Percent Cover across ZM rows for that quadrat-year; if the quadrat is observed but has no ZM row, assign 0 because the table enumerates seagrass species observed; if ZM is observed only with NA cover, focal cover is missing for quantitative averaging
annual_state.focal_frequency: number of observed quadrats with ZM observed / number of observed quadrats
annual_state.focal_mean_cover: mean focal_cover_quadrat across quadrats with known focal cover, including inferred 0 only for observed RM-only quadrats
annual_state.survey_count: number of distinct sampling dates in the transect-year
annual_state.recorded_presence: at least one observed quadrat has a ZM row
annual_state.recorded_loss_state: at least six observed quadrats and zero ZM-observed quadrats; this is ZM not observed among re-observed seagrass-bearing quadrats, not bare-habitat absence
annual_state.unavailable: fewer than six observed quadrats, fewer than six quadrats with known focal cover, or no seagrass row for the transect-year; excluded, never zero

transition_endpoint.source_eligibility: source transect-year recorded_presence and quantitative state eligible
transition_endpoint.target: same stable transect in immediately following calendar year
transition_endpoint.interpretation: loss of recorded Zostera from re-observed seagrass-bearing permanent quadrats; not demographic extinction and not total meadow disappearance

model.split: strict walk-forward by target year; train only transitions with target year earlier than the scored year
model.numeric_scaling: StandardScaler fitted on each training set only
model.categorical_encoding: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') fitted on each training set only

scoring.aggregation: unweighted mean across prospectively scorable target years
scoring.favorable: augmented macro log loss < baseline AND augmented wins >= ceil(0.60 * scored target years)
scoring.adverse: baseline macro log loss < augmented AND baseline wins >= ceil(0.60 * scored target years)
secondary: pooled ROC AUC if both classes

no_rescue: Do not treat a missing transect-year or missing Percent Cover as Zostera absence.
Do not count a bare/unsampled quadrat that has no RM/ZM row as an observed zero.
Do not switch to Ruppia after response access.
Do not change the six-quadrat eligibility threshold after response access.
Do not add density, biomass, canopy height, salinity, disease or other columns to rescue the endpoint.
Do not lower estimability minima or remove adverse years after response access.
Any schema/linkage/estimability failure is terminal for v2.
